authorized_by: PYQUATICUS_4V4_ORACLE_COMPOSITION_RESULT.json (decision_label NO_ORACLE_COMPOSITION_CONFIRMATION; its sequencing_lock step 4 defers a successor selector until the oracle result is interpreted, which it now is)
RESEARCH_QUESTION: Can ONE deterministic selector, reading only predeclared observable game state and never the pole/regime identity, switch between 2A/2D and 4A/0D within an episode and preserve the useful behavior that each regime-specific fixed composition produced?
WHY_THIS_IS_A_NEW_QUESTION: The oracle test asked whether a known regime label can be mapped to a good fixed composition. Its plumbing was correct (oracle parity 0 mismatches over 384 rows) and it still did not confirm, because the A-side gain over the wrong fixed composition did not clear zero. This spec asks the genuinely different question: whether the SAME composition decision can be recovered from state the team can actually observe, with no label handed to it.

TWO_PHASE_FREEZE.why: The PI's constraint: do not freeze pressure thresholds because they sound right. Derive the rule from observable semantics and execution logic first, then freeze the numbers before any outcome data exists.
PHASE_1_frozen_here: the research question and claim boundary
the permitted observable input set and the anti-leak architecture
the arms, controls, pairing and estimands
the contract gates, including forced mid-episode switching
the success gate and the null interpretation
the procedure by which Phase-2 thresholds must be derived
TWO_PHASE_FREEZE.PHASE_2_frozen_later: The concrete feature definitions and threshold VALUES, in PYQUATICUS_4V4_STATE_CONDITIONED_COMPOSITION_SELECTOR_V1_THRESHOLD_AMENDMENT.json, written and frozen BEFORE a single 4v4 outcome episode is run. Deriving them may read scripted-controller source, execution logic, and outcome-blind state traces. It may NOT read any win rate, score, or outcome contrast from this spec's arms.
TWO_PHASE_FREEZE.violation_condition: Any threshold chosen or altered after an outcome number is seen voids the run. The result would then be a knob-shopping exercise, which is the specific failure this structure exists to prevent.

EXECUTION_PATH_INSPECTION.purpose: Recorded so Phase 2 derives from real machinery rather than assumption, and so the spec does not freeze an unbuildable contract.
EXECUTION_PATH_INSPECTION.composition_is_currently_episode_fixed: experiments/run_pyquaticus_4v4_role_composition_sweep.py::run_episode computes roles = composition_roles(composition) ONCE before the horizon loop, then calls _action_for_roles(core, roles) every tick with that fixed tuple. Mid-episode switching is therefore NOT currently implemented.
EXECUTION_PATH_INSPECTION.but_it_is_a_small_localized_change: Because _action_for_roles already takes live core and already runs per tick, a state-conditioned selector only needs roles recomputed inside the loop. No new environment machinery is required.
EXECUTION_PATH_INSPECTION.schema_already_anticipates_it: The episode row schema already carries role_switch_count, currently hard-coded to 0. This spec makes it a real measured quantity.
EXECUTION_PATH_INSPECTION.role_to_macro_mapping: experiments/run_pyquaticus_4v4_team_evaluation.py::_action_for_roles: role 1 -> MacroAction.DEFEND; role 0 -> GO_HOME when the team is carrying, else GET_FLAG. Attackers are therefore ALREADY state-conditioned on team carrier state; only the attacker/defender SPLIT is fixed.
EXECUTION_PATH_INSPECTION.defend_macro_dependency: role 1 resolves to MacroAction.DEFEND (=7), the unified primitive sealed by DEFEND_SEMANTIC_COMMITMENT_V2_CONTRACT_RESULT.json as REPRESENTABLE_ACROSS_TRANSITIONS (target error exactly 0.000 across branch flips). This experiment is downstream of that result and is not interpretable without it.
EXECUTION_PATH_INSPECTION.eval_vocabulary: The evaluation env sets n_macros=8 explicitly to admit DEFEND=7. Production configs remain at n_macros=5, so nothing here widens any learned policy's action space.
EXECUTION_PATH_INSPECTION.identity_is_held_fixed: composition_roles assigns defender roles to the lowest agent indices. Identity assignment was already tested and is not the lever, so it is held fixed and is out of scope; only the COUNT changes.

ANTI_LEAK_ARCHITECTURE.requirement: No pole label, opponent genome id, genome hash, certification record, arm name, or any other regime shortcut may reach the selector.
ANTI_LEAK_ARCHITECTURE.structural_enforcement_not_a_promise: The selector MUST NOT receive the core object or the pole string. A separate extraction step reads core and returns a declared feature dict; the selector's only argument is that dict. Undeclared state is therefore unreachable by construction, not merely forbidden by convention.
ANTI_LEAK_ARCHITECTURE.mechanical_leak_test: A contract gate constructs two states that are identical in every declared feature but were produced under different poles, and asserts the selector returns the identical composition. A selector that can distinguish them has leaked and the run is void.
ANTI_LEAK_ARCHITECTURE.oracle_is_reference_only: The pole-aware oracle arm may be reported side by side as a descriptive upper reference. It is NOT an eligible input, NOT a fitting target, and NOT part of any gate.

PERMITTED_OBSERVABLE_INPUTS.note: The exact feature set and thresholds are Phase 2. This is the permitted universe Phase 2 may draw from -- all verified present on the live core.
PERMITTED_OBSERVABLE_INPUTS.own_flag_state: blue_flag_pos versus blue_flag_home (whether our flag is displaced/taken)
PERMITTED_OBSERVABLE_INPUTS.team_carrier_state: blue_carrying (whether any teammate holds the enemy flag)
PERMITTED_OBSERVABLE_INPUTS.threat_geometry: alive enemy positions relative to our own flag and our own half, e.g. counts within a declared radius and nearest-enemy distance
PERMITTED_OBSERVABLE_INPUTS.clock: tick index within the frozen 240-tick horizon
explicitly_forbidden_inputs: opponent genome id, genome hash, or certification record
any opponent internal parameter such as lock_defender or enable_2v1
any outcome field: score, win, reward, return

PHASE_2_DERIVATION_PROCEDURE.step_1: From the scripted opponent controllers' own source, identify what observable footprint distinguishes an opponent that pressures our flag from one that does not. This is a reading of execution logic, not of outcomes.
PHASE_2_DERIVATION_PROCEDURE.step_2: Collect outcome-blind state traces under both poles with fixed compositions, and report the distribution of each candidate feature. Outcome fields must be neither serialized nor printed.
PHASE_2_DERIVATION_PROCEDURE.step_3: Choose thresholds from those distributions by a stated, mechanical criterion declared in the amendment BEFORE the values are computed -- for example a separating point between the two observed distributions -- not by trying values against win rate.
PHASE_2_DERIVATION_PROCEDURE.step_4: Freeze the amendment. Only then run the outcome arms.
PHASE_2_DERIVATION_PROCEDURE.single_rule_constraint: Exactly one rule with one threshold set is frozen. No grid, no per-pole variant, no post-hoc alternative is eligible.

ARMS_AND_CONTROLS.STATE_SELECTOR: the Phase-2 rule, run identically on both poles
ARMS_AND_CONTROLS.ORACLE_REGIME: descriptive upper reference only, reported, never gating
ARMS_AND_CONTROLS.poles: A and B, both evaluated with the identical selector
ARMS_AND_CONTROLS.pairing: the same fresh paired seed used in every arm and both poles
ARMS_AND_CONTROLS.seeds: a fresh exploratory block allocated via seed_registry next_free at Phase 2. 20100001-20100064 is SPENT by the oracle test and must not be reused.
ARMS_AND_CONTROLS.bootstrap: 95 percent deterministic bootstrap over paired seeds, NUM_BOOT=20000, matching the oracle test
ARMS_AND_CONTROLS.controllers: Pyquaticus ATTACK/DEFEND semantics held exactly fixed. Only composition selection changes.

CONTRACT_GATES_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_EPISOD.C1_NO_REGIME_LEAK: The mechanical leak test above passes.
CONTRACT_GATES_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_EPISOD.C2_FORCED_SWITCH_FIXTURES: Deterministic fixtures constructed to drive the declared features across their thresholds mid-episode. The selector must demonstrably change composition on these fixtures. A rule that never switches cannot reach the outcome stage, because it would be a fixed composition wearing a selector's name.
CONTRACT_GATES_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_EPISOD.C3_SWITCH_IS_REAL_IN_EXECUTION: role_switch_count becomes a genuinely measured field, and on the forced-switch fixtures the per-tick macro vector observably changes between 2A/2D and 4A/0D patterns.
CONTRACT_GATES_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_EPISOD.C4_CONTROL_PARITY: With the selector pinned to a constant output, the arm must reproduce the corresponding FIXED control bit-identically on outcome and telemetry -- the same parity discipline the oracle test passed with 0 mismatches.
CONTRACT_GATES_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_EPISOD.C5_OUTCOME_BLIND_UNTIL_PHASE_2_SEALED: No outcome field is read, serialized or printed during Phase-2 derivation.
CONTRACT_GATES_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_EPISOD.FAILURE_RULE: Any failed gate stops execution before a seed is spent.

SUCCESS_GATE.primary: Under ONE state-based rule with no pole identity: gain over the WRONG fixed composition has LCB95 > 0 on BOTH poles. Concretely, selector minus FIXED_4A0D on Pole A, and selector minus FIXED_2A2D on Pole B. This mirrors the oracle test's frozen two-sided gate exactly.
SUCCESS_GATE.supporting_reported: selector versus each matched fixed control, role_switch_count distribution, switch timing, score difference, draw rate, episode length, and the oracle arm as descriptive reference.

PREREGISTERED_CEILING_CAVEAT.statement: The A-side gate may be hard to clear for a reason that has nothing to do with selector quality, and this is recorded BEFORE the run so it cannot be invoked afterwards as an excuse.
PREREGISTERED_CEILING_CAVEAT.evidence: In the oracle result, FIXED_2A2D minus FIXED_4A0D on Pole A was +0.171875 with LCB95 exactly 0.0. The A-side advantage of the 'right' composition is itself marginal at n=64, so even a perfect selector has very little headroom to clear an LCB95>0 gate there.
PREREGISTERED_CEILING_CAVEAT.consequence: If the run returns B-side pass and A-side fail, that is the EXPECTED shape given this ceiling and must be reported as 'A-side underpowered at this n' rather than as evidence the selector failed. It also must not be used to argue the gate should be loosened after the fact. If more A-side power is wanted, that is a sample-size decision to make in Phase 2, before running.

DECISION_RULE.STATE_CONDITIONED_COMPOSITION_CONFIRMED: All contract gates pass and both primary gains clear LCB95 > 0. Evidence that state -> composition -> role behavior is recoverable without a regime label.
DECISION_RULE.PARTIAL_B_ONLY: B clears, A does not. Report as-is with the ceiling caveat above. Does not authorize PPO or 6v6.
DECISION_RULE.NO_STATE_CONDITIONED_CONFIRMATION: Neither clears, or the selector never meaningfully switches. Interpretation: composition is a strong B-side lever but THIS state-conditioned rule is insufficient. Explicitly NOT 'composition does not matter', and explicitly NOT a licence to try a second rule inside this spec.
DECISION_RULE.claim_ceiling: Even full confirmation establishes only that a scripted selector recovers composition from observable state under these two frozen opponents at 4v4. It says nothing about a learned selector, PPO trainability, or 6v6.

ISOLATION.production_interface_changes: NONE -- no new macro, no n_macros change, no engine edit

SEQUENCING_LOCK: 2. Derive features and thresholds per PHASE_2_DERIVATION_PROCEDURE, outcome-blind
4. Implement the selector, the extraction step, and the forced-switch fixtures
6. Allocate a fresh seed block only after all gates pass
7. Run the paired outcome cells and freeze the result
8. PPO and 6v6 remain blocked regardless of outcome and require their own freezes
NOT_AUTHORIZED: PPO, GPU, 6v6, or any learned selector
tuning thresholds after any outcome number is seen
adding a second candidate rule inside this spec
treating the oracle arm as an input or fitting target
loosening the success gate after seeing the A-side result
authorizes: Phase-2 outcome-blind derivation only. No seed allocation, no outcome episode.
